rules: Timeouts are measured in A620-UPTIME-MS-1 and expire at the inclusive deadline.
A watchdog failure never fabricates RESULT_READY, ACK_RESULT_COMMITTED, or a FormalTrainingResult.
The durable outbox may continue exact-byte retry until the watchdog interrupts or the runtime is superseded.
RUNTIME_ERROR is an immediate watchdog failure regardless of the remaining timeout budget.
